title: Wild Mushroom Ragout on Polenta
subtitle: Rich mushroom sauce served over creamy parmesan polenta
excerpt: Chestnut mushrooms and any available wild mushrooms are cooked down with garlic, thyme, and red wine vinegar into a thick, savoury ragout. It is served over soft polenta enriched with butter and parmesan. A satisfying vegetarian main.
sourceNotes: Inspired by Northern Italian mushroom preparations. Polenta is the traditional base in Lombardy and the Veneto for rich meat and vegetable sauces.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The mushroom ragout can be made 2 days ahead. Make the polenta fresh as it sets solid when cold.

content.text: Use chestnut mushrooms as the base and add any wild mushrooms you can find. Dried wild mushrooms, rehydrated in warm water, work well and add a more intense flavour.

items.prepNote: mix of chestnut and any available wild mushrooms, thickly sliced
200ml for the ragout, 600ml for the polenta
40g for the ragout, 20g for the polenta

content.text: Make the ragout. Melt 40g butter in a large frying pan over high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer. Cook undisturbed for 3 minutes until golden, then stir and cook 2 more minutes.
Reduce heat to medium. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, thyme, and rosemary. Cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the red wine vinegar. Let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock. Simmer for 10 minutes until the liquid is reduced by half.
Stir in the cream. Cook for 3 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy. Remove thyme stems. Stir in parsley.
Make the polenta. Bring 600ml vegetable stock to a boil in a large saucepan. Pour in the polenta in a steady stream, whisking constantly.
Reduce heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon, until thick and smooth. Stir in 20g butter and the parmesan. Season with salt.
Spoon the polenta into bowls. Top with the mushroom ragout.

items.cause: Poured in too fast or not whisked quickly enough
items.fix: Keep whisking on low heat until lumps dissolve.

items.cause: Too many mushrooms in the pan at once
items.fix: Cook in two batches in a very hot pan.
Add a pinch of sugar and simmer 3 more minutes.
